# Runly

> Task marketplace connecting people across Canada with verified local runners for errands, delivery, and same-day tasks. Post a task for free; pay only when it's done.

## What Runly does
- Post any errand or task — parcel pickup and delivery, grocery shopping, sending gifts, home assembly, dog walking, airport drop-offs, admin errands, and more — and a verified local runner in your city picks it up.
- Posting a task is free. Payment is held securely in escrow until the poster confirms the task is complete, then released to the runner.
- Runners complete identity verification before their first task; posters can see a runner's rating, completed task count, and reviews before accepting a bid.
- Most tasks receive bids within 15–30 minutes; same-day completion is common for delivery and shopping tasks.
- Available in English and French.

## Coverage
Live in 23 Canadian cities: Toronto, Hamilton, Mississauga, Brampton, London, Kitchener, Ottawa, Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Calgary, Edmonton, Montreal, Quebec City, Laval, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina, Halifax, Moncton, Fredericton, St. John's, Charlottetown.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://runly.ca/en
- Browse open tasks: https://runly.ca/en/tasks/browse
- Post a task: https://runly.ca/en/tasks/new
- Become a runner / earnings: https://runly.ca/en/earnings
- City pages: https://runly.ca/en/{city-slug}, e.g. https://runly.ca/en/toronto, https://runly.ca/en/vancouver

## FAQ
Q: How much does it cost to post a task?
A: Posting a task on Runly is completely free. You only pay when a runner accepts and completes it.

Q: Is Runly available across Canada?
A: Yes. Runly is live in 23 Canadian cities, including Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton, Winnipeg, and Halifax, and growing.

Q: How do I know the runner is trustworthy?
A: Every runner completes identity verification before their first task. You can see their rating, completed task count, and reviews before accepting a bid.

Q: When does the runner get paid?
A: Payment is held securely by Runly until you confirm the task is done. The runner only receives payment after you mark the task as complete.

Q: What kinds of tasks can I post?
A: Almost anything: parcel pickup and delivery, grocery shopping, sending gifts, home assembly, dog walking, airport drop-offs, admin errands, and more.

Q: How quickly can a runner start my task?
A: Most tasks receive bids within 15–30 minutes. Same-day completion is common for delivery and shopping tasks.
